entries.title: VS Code v1_146: Trust and security
entries.description: Improved permission prompts The Copilot harness previously suggested overly broad tool-level allowances for operations like web fetches, terminal commands, and file reads. For example, the default action for fetching a URL was "Allow in this Session", which would let the model access any URL during that session. Now, permission prompts are more granular, by default adding allowances for specific domains, commands, and directories.

What's new in v1.1.27

 Highlights

- Added version history to the artifact editor, so you can view and preview previous versions of an edited artifact.
- WSL sessions now show images and file edits returned by tool calls directly in the conversation, including expandable diffs.
- You can now resume an interrupted coordinator agent and its child sessions directly from the sidebar.
- Video attachments now appear alongside images in the conversation's media grid, with preview and playback support.

- The Goal pill in the composer now shows live status and expands to show the objective, completion summary, and AI Credits usage.

entries.title: Lars Vogel: Faster startup of the Eclipse IDE by 600ms
entries.description:
Good news for everyone using Eclipse with Maven: your IDE now starts about 600ms faster. While building its menus at startup, Eclipse activated the m2e UI plug-in, which then waited on a lock held by a background job.
The result was a frozen UI thread for about 600ms on every start.
The details are in m2e-core issue #2237 . We found it with our tracing tools, by sampling thread dumps during startup.
